responsibility: This file implements GCC’s transactional memory lowering and IPA support. It handles the staged transformation of transaction constructs from front-end GENERIC/GIMPLE forms through EH-aware transaction regions to final TM builtin calls and restart edges, provides query helpers for TM-safe/pure/callable attributes, performs interprocedural analysis to discover irrevocable or clone-required callees, creates and redirects transactional clones, diagnoses invalid TM-safe usage, and rewrites memory accesses and calls inside transactions. Its responsibility is the full middle-end and IPA implementation of transactional memory semantics in GCC.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/trans-mem.h, which only publishes transactional-memory flags and helper declarations for other files, this source file contains the actual transactional-memory implementation: lowering of transaction constructs, TM attribute/query logic, IPA analysis, clone creation/redirection, and the tmipa pass.
